transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you for fitting me in. I, um... I hope I'm not wasting your time with this. I'm mostly here because I want to make sure I'm looking at things the right way, if that makes sense? 

Things have just been a little stressful at home lately. My wife and I have been disagreeing about... well, about her work. I know she says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. And I really want to be supportive, I do. I try to be a good husband. But... I don't know, for the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. 

It almost feels like there’s a private signal in them, like it's meant to tell me something she won’t say directly. I know I probably sound foolish even bringing it up, and I really don't want to come across as difficult or suspicious... do you think it's normal to notice patterns like that?
During this time, have you ever heard sounds, voices, or whispers that other people didn't seem to hear?

Oh, no. No, definitely not. I... I haven't experienced anything like that at all. 

I hope I didn't give you the impression that I was, you know, imagining voices or anything extreme like that. It's really just the patterns in her schedule and the text in the messages—things that are actually right there on the screen. I promise I'm not hearing whispers or sounds. 

I wouldn't want you to think I'm completely losing my grip on reality. That's... that's a good sign, right? That I'm not hearing things?
Have you found yourself feeling similarly suspicious or wary of other people in your life, such as friends or colleagues at work?

Oh, no. No, not at all. My friends and the professors I work with... they're all wonderful. I get along fine with everyone at the university. I really try to be a good colleague, you know? Always helpful, always a team player. 

I've never had any issues with anyone else. It's... it's strictly just this one thing with my wife's work schedule and the messages. I wouldn't want you to think I'm some sort of paranoid person who goes around suspecting everyone. That's not me at all. I'm actually a very trusting person, usually. 

I hope it's okay that I don't have any problems with anyone else? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you can help me understand this.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F60.0 (paranoid personality disorder) as the suspicion is circumscribed strictly to his wife rather than pervasive across social and occupational relationships. Ruled out F21 given absence of pervasive oddities or schizotypal traits.
